addr: Opposite to State bank of India, Koramangala Industrial Layout, No 3, 20th Main Rd, 7th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560095, India

rev.t: This is a co-work space with nice facilities.  It has pool table, outdoor seating, table tennis table, Foose ball and ample space for more than 100 people to accommodate. This place also has been a part of many events such as Hackathons and seminars. Overall a nice place to sit and work in peace.

A superb place to work. Nice and cozy place with a lot of talented minds all over the place. A bunch of games equipment, open and closed working space options, an open terrace for everyone makes it a place that you will love to explore your ideas in.

I had been here to conduct a recruitment drive. The place and ambience is well maintained. Even though we paid a ransom amount for the place, we were not supposed to use coffee machines or the food facilities. We had to pay for everything. A little disappointed with this. Other than this fact, everything’s good
